messages:
lina: quick sync — we have a small cutover window for the v2 endpoints next Tue 09:00-11:00 PT. need to confirm who can hold post-cut smoke for SDKs + gateway. short checklist below and PR queue: 

lina: PRs blocking cutover: 
- api: redwood/redwood-api#4521 (header negotiation fallback) 
- sdk-js: redwood/sdk-js#289 (embed header compat) 
- proxy: redwood/proxy#1178 (route fallback rules)

lina: can folks call dibs on reviews or point to owners? i can rotate on-call but want owners for rollout window. @max @anita @sam

max: i can take proxy PR review and smoke proxy routing on cutover. will run the canary script Tuesday 08:30. pls add me to the deploy slot. :+1:

anita: i'll review sdk-js PR and run local integration with the new header. note: i saw one test flake in embed header unit tests — lowering concurrency fixed it locally.

sam: depends on api PR — i'm owner there but heads up i have a support call Tue 09:15-09:45. i'll handoff a quick runbook to kai if it overlaps.

kai: i can standby for api post-cut checks. also i'll validate telemetry flags (cost/latency dash) once cut is live.

lina: perfect. devex-bot — can you surface the CI status for the three PRs and attach failing tests?

devex-bot: CI summary: api#4521 (checks: 6/7 pass, flaky-integ failing), sdk-js#289 (checks: 5/5 pass), proxy#1178 (checks: 4/4 pass). failing test: api-integ::header_matrix.test.js (timeout on slow runner). Link: https://ci.internal/4312009876/overview

lina: ok — action items: 
- max: proxy review + canary script (assigned)
- anita: sdk-js review + integration (assigned)
- sam -> kai: handoff runbook for api overlap (sam to DM kai)
- lina: schedule deploy slot and update cutover doc with deploy commands and rollback checklist

lina: quick note on rollback: use route toggle in proxy: `POST /admin/routes/toggle {"v2_enabled": false}` then revert header negotiation change in API deployment. keep a contact list in the doc.

anita: adding a short test case to sdk-js to assert header fallback behavior. will ping when merged.

max: posted a short checklist in the cutover doc and claimed the 08:30 canary slot.

sam: i'll DM kai the runbook now. if anyone can't attend, please comment here so we re-assign.

lina: thanks — i'll post final cutover doc link and invite people to the Tuesday channel around EOD today. :rocket:
